facts: Parties: Ivybridge Industries Ltd (Buyer), Fenwick Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Redcliffe Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 17 March 2027; Closing is scheduled for 20 May 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $13,200,000. The Purchase Price is $165,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 17 March 2027), either party may terminate.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 29 June 2027.
